title: Keep the report
story: summarize.sh prints a summary of {{run}}, but it scrolls away. Save what it prints to a file called summary.txt instead.

~/{{project}}/summarize.sh.content:
#!/bin/bash
echo "Run: {{run}}"
echo "Designs: 96"
echo "Best design: design_0{{best}} (score -1.83)"
echo "Mean pLDDT: 87.2"

tasks.text: Save the output of summarize.sh in summary.txt

hints: `>` sends what a command prints into a file instead of the screen.
